## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Scope

- [ ] Standards
- [ ] Schemas or manifests
- [ ] Product workspace(s):
- [ ] CI/CD or release workflow
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests

## Security and privacy

Describe threat-model, trust-boundary, secret-handling, and data-minimization impact. State why the change does not weaken a security control, or document the approved exception.

## Compatibility and migration

Describe breaking changes, affected product versions, migration steps, rollback, and compatibility evidence.

## Verification

List commands and workflows run. Include relevant output or links.

- [ ] Unit/regression tests
- [ ] Schema validation
- [ ] Workflow validation
- [ ] Monorepo validation
- [ ] Product runtime checks (where applicable)
- [ ] Repository hygiene scan

## Limitations and release notes

List checks not run, unsupported configurations, known limitations, and changelog updates.
